card.name: Verbs of handling and storing before use
card.fires_on: The verb or word right after 'allow to', 'should be', or 'keep' in product handling and storage steps, such as kept, come, sit, brought, shipped. It is mostly found where a product is warmed, stored or moved before use.

modes.label: Warming to room temperature
modes.description: Verb or word after 'allow to' or 'to' when a refrigerated item is left to reach room temperature.
modes.example: allow to<< sit>> at room temperature for 30 minutes

modes.label: Keeping or shipping product
modes.description: Verb about how a product is kept, shipped or moved.
modes.example: AVANCE is<< shipped>> on dry ice in validated insulated shipping containers

modes.label: Instruction verbs before a care step
modes.description: Passive or helper word in instructions about what is done to patients or items next.
modes.example: patients should<< be>> monitored for elevation in intraocular
